title: Loss Analysis dashboard (API + UI)
objective: Loss Analysis per spec FR-59 / PRD 16: five KPIs (no Win-back Potential), reason/product bars, loss trend, competitor table, loss commentary feed, plus the drill-down loss report views with pre-/post-quote distinction.
scope: Drill-down views: loss counts by reason, trend by reason, by cover type, by broker, by RM, price-gap analysis (via drill endpoint keys)
implementation_details: Features/Dashboards/LossAnalysis/GetLossAnalysisQuery: KPIs — LostPremium (falling delta green), QuotesLost, TopLossReason (mode by count), AvgPriceGap (mean % gap between quoted premium and competitor premium where competitor premium known), TopCompetitor (most lost-to); LostPremiumByReason: horizontal bars (danger hue) one per reason with amounts; LostPremiumTrend: 6-month line with area fill; LostPremiumByProductLine: horizontal bars (amber); CompetitorAnalysis table {competitor, dealsLost, premiumLost, avgPriceGapPct}; LossCommentary feed: recent lost items {client + product line, loss comment one-liner, loss-reason chip, premium}

Drill registry keys: loss.count_by_reason (split pre-quote vs post-quote via lost_before_quote), loss.trend_by_reason, loss.by_cover_type, loss.by_broker, loss.by_rm, loss.price_gap — each returning the drilldown fields from PRD 16.3 (client, broker, RM, product, cover, quoted premium, lost premium, reason, before/after quote, competitor, competitor premium, decision date, comments)
features/dashboards/LossAnalysisPage.tsx: KPI row (5 cards), chart rows per PRD layout, CommentaryFeed full-width; drill links under each chart

findings.description: AC-080 unit-test gap for the new formula. MetricDefinitions.AveragePriceGap was added by T-036 into the AC-080-governed single-home formula class, and the handler correctly delegates to it (GetLossAnalysisQueryHandler line 86 and CompetitorAnalysis line 177). But QuoteIQ.Domain.Tests/Metrics/MetricDefinitionsTests.cs has a dedicated unit test (known-inputs + zero-denominator, plus defensive-exclusion where relevant) for EVERY sibling formula (ConversionRate, LeadToQuoteRate, QuoteToProposalRate, ProposalToWinRate, AverageLeadAgeDays, AverageQuoteAgeDays, AverageTurnaroundDays, FollowUpCompliance, OpenPipelinePremium) yet NONE for AveragePriceGap. Its three documented behaviors (mean of (our-comp)/comp gaps; null when no usable pairs; defensive exclusion of zero/negative competitor premiums) have zero Domain-level unit coverage — only indirect, partly-circular integration coverage in AvgPriceGap_ShouldUseOnlyRecordsWithKnownCompetitorPremium.
findings.evidence: MetricDefinitionsTests.cs Facts enumerated for all other methods; grep for 'AveragePriceGap'/'PriceGap' in QuoteIQ.Domain.Tests returns no matches. AC-080: 'each [formula] lives in exactly one named, unit-tested class'.
findings.resolution: Added 3 Domain unit tests to MetricDefinitionsTests.cs against the real IReadOnlyCollection<(decimal OurPremium, decimal CompetitorPremium)> signature, matching the sibling AverageTurnaroundDays style (AAA, MethodName_WhenCondition_ShouldExpectedOutcome): AveragePriceGap_GivenKnownPairs_ShouldAverageGaps ((120k,100k),(220k,200k),(360k,300k) -> 0.1667 at precision 4), AveragePriceGap_WhenNoUsablePairs_ShouldReturnNull (empty -> null), AveragePriceGap_WhenCompetitorPremiumZeroOrNegative_ShouldExcludeDefensively (zero and negative competitor premiums excluded, only the usable pair contributes 0.20). Domain.Tests count 383 -> 386, all green.
findings.evaluator_verification: CONFIRMED RESOLVED (iteration 2/10 re-audit). The 3 tests exist (MetricDefinitionsTests.cs:178-216) and call the real production signature MetricDefinitions.AveragePriceGap(IReadOnlyCollection<(decimal OurPremium, decimal CompetitorPremium)>) verbatim (MetricDefinitions.cs:163). Genuineness verified, not tautological: (a) known-pairs expected value 0.1667 is an independent hand computation of ((0.20+0.10+0.20)/3), asserted at precision 4; (b) empty->null exercises the zero-gap-count branch; (c) the zero/negative-competitor case exercises the defensive `CompetitorPremium > 0m` filter (line 166) and asserts 0.20, proving both bad rows are dropped rather than dividing-by-zero or inverting the sign. `dotnet test QuoteIQ.slnx` green with no regression: Domain.Tests 386/386 (was 383, +3), Application.Tests 32/32, Api.Tests 306/306, Infrastructure.Tests 91/91. MetricDefinitions.cs production impl unchanged.

findings.description: Evaluator rulings on the Implementor's three flagged spec ambiguities (all ACCEPTED as non-blocking): (1) Permission gate = dashboards.view_loss_analysis — CORRECT; the dedicated per-dashboard permission exists in PermissionCatalog (line 186) and PRD 20.5, matches sibling dashboards, and LossAnalysis_WhenCallerLacksViewLossAnalysisPermission_ShouldReturn403 proves denial. (2) AvgPriceGap = mean of (ourPremium-competitorPremium)/competitorPremium over known positive competitor premiums, ourPremium = quoted-else-estimated — REASONABLE against PRD 16; sign convention (positive = we quoted above competitor) is sound, null-safe, and the estimated fallback for pre-quote losses is the only comparable figure. (3) lost_before_quote: true=Pre-quote, false=Post-quote, sourced from the workflow-set lead column — matches PRD 16.3 and is proven by ReasonDrill_ShouldDistinguishPreQuoteFromPostQuoteLosses (2 pre + 2 post, XOR). Also confirmed non-blocking: KPI deltas null (no baseline, Pipeline/Broker/RM precedent) and the describe.fixme e2e deferral (blocked on T-041 seed, matches dashboard-rm/dashboard-brokers precedent).

DOCUMENTED PRD DEVIATIONS honored: (1) the prototype's SIXTH KPI 'Win-back Potential' is intentionally omitted (spec §2 / PRD 16.0 exclusion) — five KPI cards instead of six; (2) the prototype's mock per-KPI deltas ('down 7% vs Apr 1-30' etc.) are not reproduced — deltas are null with GoodDirection still set (lower-is-better), matching the Pipeline/Broker/RM 'no reliable prior-period baseline' precedent, so a falling delta would render green once a baseline exists.

Spec ambiguities FLAGGED (documented in GetLossAnalysisQueryHandler XML remarks, not silently resolved): (1) Loss-analysis permission gate resolved to the dedicated dashboards.view_loss_analysis (PermissionCatalog + PRD 20.5 both already define it) — NOT a view_executive fallback. (2) AvgPriceGap definition: gap per record = (ourPremium - competitorPremium)/competitorPremium averaged over ONLY records with a known/positive competitor premium; 'ourPremium' = current quoted premium when the lead reached a quote, else estimated premium (so a pre-quote loss that carries a competitor premium contributes via its estimate — the only comparable figure). (3) lost_before_quote pre/post-quote split: true = lost before any quote was sent (Pre-quote flag), false = lost after a quote (Post-quote flag), sourced directly from the lead's lost_before_quote column set by the MarkLeadLost / MarkQuoteLost workflows. Additional documented decisions: 'Quotes Lost' counts lost LEADS (the loss records, labeled per the PRD KPI name, carried as a lead metric); Lost Premium per record = quoted-else-estimated; the by-product-line bars and the by_broker/by_rm drill keys resolve to the shared AllLost lost-lead scope (only price_gap narrows to known-competitor-premium records), mirroring the pipeline OverdueQuotes->OpenPipeline shared-scope precedent; the date filter windows on received date (shared DashboardFilter semantics) while the trend buckets by decision date.
